Subject: POC readiness & success criteria — Mosaic Retail evaluation

Hi Emma — great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed 3-week POC plan so we can align on scope and owners:

Recap (from our discovery):
- Goal: reduce agent handle time on returns by 30% with an LLM-assisted summary + suggested resolution flows.
- Key systems: Order DB (read-only), Returns CRM, product taxonomy API.
- Non-starters: no customer data leaves their VPC; logs must be auditable.

Proposed POC (high level):
Week 0 (prep): network connectivity test, sample data extract (anonymized), finalize success metrics.
Week 1: baseline evaluation (human-only), small model integration, generate responses for 2k historical tickets.
Week 2: live shadow testing on 10% of inbound returns; collect latency/correctness metrics.
Week 3: evaluation, scoring, and handoff to your ops for pilot decision.

Success metrics I suggest we commit to for acceptance:
- Accuracy: >= 85% on suggested resolution match vs. historical outcome (sampling).
- Latency: 99th percentile < 450ms for generation on 1k concurrent prefix requests.
- Ops: no PII leaks in outputs; SOC2 controls verified by audit artifacts.

Owners (proposed):
- Mosaic: Emma Brown (product lead), Rajiv Menon (infra).
- Redwood: Rishi (engagement lead), Ben Carter (commercial), Marissa Cole (CS lead — will run acceptance).

Open items for your confirmation:
1) Can your infra team schedule a 30-minute connectivity window next week for the VPC peering test? (we can provide a checklist)
2) Can you share a 200-ticket anonymized sample by EOD Friday?
3) Any additional regulatory requirements beyond SOC2 we should know about?

I attached a simple POC checklist and a one-pager on proposed success metrics. If that looks good I can circulate a dated runbook and calendar invites for Week 0 tasks.

Thanks — speak soon,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai
